cedictSenses: in two minds about sth (idiom)
half-hearted
shilly-shallying
entries.mapullExplanation: 又想这样又想那样，犹豫不定。常指不安心，不专一。

cedictSenses: roads open in all directions (idiom); accessible from all sides
entries.mapullExplanation: 四面八方都有路可通。形容交通极便利。也形容通向各方。

cedictSenses: out of one's wits (idiom)
distracted
stunned
entries.mapullExplanation: 六神：道家认为人的心、肺、肝、肾、脾、胆各有神灵主宰，称为六神。形容惊慌着急，没了主意，不知如何才好。

cedictSenses: (lit.) one hair from nine oxen (idiom)
(fig.) a drop in the ocean
entries.mapullExplanation: 九条牛身上的一根毛。比喻极大数量中极微小的数量，微不足道。

cedictSenses: lit. to cover one's ears whilst stealing a bell
to deceive oneself
to bury one's head in the sand (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 掩：遮蔽，遮盖；盗：偷。偷铃铛怕别人听见而捂住自己的耳朵。比喻自己欺骗自己，明明掩盖不住的事情偏要想法子掩盖。

cedictSenses: lit. a notch on the side of a boat to locate a sword dropped overboard (idiom); fig. an action made pointless by changed circumstances
entries.mapullExplanation: 比喻不懂事物已发展变化而仍静止地看问题。

cedictSenses: lit. the fox exploits the tiger's might (idiom); fig. to use powerful connections to intimidate people
entries.mapullExplanation: 假：借。狐狸假借老虎的威势。比喻依仗别人的势力欺压人。

cedictSenses: lit. Lord Ye's passion for dragons (idiom)
fig. to pretend to be fond of sth while actually fearing it
ostensible fondness of sth one really fears
entries.mapullExplanation: 叶公：春秋时楚国贵族，名子高，封于叶（古邑名，今河南叶县）。比喻口头上说爱好某事物，实际上并不真爱好。

cedictSenses: lit. to play the lute to a cow (idiom)
fig. offering a treat to an unappreciative audience
to cast pearls before swine
caviar to the general
to preach to deaf ears
to talk over sb's head
entries.mapullExplanation: 讥笑听话的人不懂对方说得是什么。用以讥笑说话的人不看对象。

cedictSenses: the old man moves mountains (idiom); fig. where there's a will, there's a way
entries.mapullExplanation: 比喻坚持不懈地改造自然和坚定不移地进行斗争。

cedictSenses: lit. to quench one's thirst by thinking of plums (idiom)
fig. to console oneself with illusions
entries.mapullExplanation: 原意是梅子酸，人想吃梅子就会流涎，因而止渴。后比喻愿望无法实现，用空想安慰自己。

cedictSenses: to start practicing at the first crow of the cock (idiom)
to be diligent in one's studies
entries.mapullExplanation: 闻：听到。听到鸡叫就起来舞剑。后比喻有志报国的人及时奋起。

cedictSenses: (idiom) it's a deal
that's settled then
entries.mapullExplanation: 一句话说定了，不再更改。比喻说话算数，决不翻悔。

cedictSenses: (idiom) (of two or more people) to take the same action without prior consultation; (usu. used adverbially) all (or both) of them, independently; as if by prior agreement
entries.mapullExplanation: 约：相约。事先没有约定而相互一致。

cedictSenses: to keep on fighting in spite of all setbacks (idiom)
to be undaunted by repeated setbacks
to be indomitable
entries.mapullExplanation: 折：挫折；挠：弯曲。比喻意志坚强，无论受到多少次挫折，毫不动摇退缩。

cedictSenses: lit. to invert root and branch (idiom); fig. confusing cause and effect
to stress the incidental over the fundamental
to put the cart before the horse
entries.mapullExplanation: 本：树根；末：树梢；置：放。比喻把主次、轻重的位置弄颠倒了。

cedictSenses: to hit on sth new (idiom); to display originality
to adopt an original approach
entries.mapullExplanation: 别：另外；心裁：心中的设计、筹划。另有一种构思或设计。指想出的办法与众不同。

cedictSenses: endless stream of horse and carriages (idiom)
heavy traffic
entries.mapullExplanation: 车象流水，马象游龙。形容来往车马很多，连续不断的热闹情景。

cedictSenses: the stream flows without stopping (idiom); unending flow
entries.mapullExplanation: 川：河流。形容行人、车马等象水流一样连续不断。

cedictSenses: to recover one's youthful vigor
to feel rejuvenated (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 反：回。由衰老恢复青春。形容老年人充满了活力。

cedictSenses: to raise one and infer three
to deduce many things from one case (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 反：类推。比喻从一件事情类推而知道其他许多事情。

cedictSenses: to work hard without complaint (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 任：担当，经受。不怕吃苦，也不怕招怨。

cedictSenses: to speak and keep one's promise (idiom); as good as one's word
entries.mapullExplanation: 说话靠得住，有信用。

cedictSenses: varying from person to person (idiom); different for each individual
entries.mapullExplanation: 因人的不同而有所差异。

cedictSenses: (idiom) to reap what one has sown; to stew in one's own juice
entries.mapullExplanation: 自己做了蠢事坏事，自己倒霉。

cedictSenses: lit. heart distracted, thoughts in turmoil (idiom); distraught with anxiety
entries.mapullExplanation: 意：心思。心思烦乱，不知怎样才好。

cedictSenses: lit. to wipe one's eyes and wait (idiom); to wait and see
entries.mapullExplanation: 拭：擦；待：等待。擦亮眼睛等着瞧。形容期望很迫切。也表示确信某件事情一定会出现。

cedictSenses: lit. thousand ways, a hundred plans (idiom); by every possible means
entries.mapullExplanation: 想尽或用尽一切办法。

cedictSenses: lit. look into one's heart, no shame (idiom); with a clear conscience
entries.mapullExplanation: 问心：问问自己。扪心自问，毫无愧色。

cedictSenses: lit. count by fives and tens (idiom); to narrate systematically and in full detail
entries.mapullExplanation: 五、十：计数单位。五个十个地将数目点清。比喻叙述从头到尾，源源本本，没有遗漏。也形容查点数目。

cedictSenses: lit. heart alarmed, body leaping (idiom); fear and trepidation in the face of disaster
entries.mapullExplanation: 形容担心灾祸临头，恐慌不安。

cedictSenses: daily renewal, monthly change (idiom)
every day sees new developments
rapid progress
entries.mapullExplanation: 新：更新；异：不同。每天都在更新，每月都有变化。指发展或进步迅速，不断出现新事物、新气象。

cedictSenses: (idiom) flourishing
thriving
entries.mapullExplanation: 欣欣：形容草木生长旺盛；荣：茂盛。形容草木长得茂盛。比喻事业蓬勃发展，兴旺昌盛。

cedictSenses: deep and unmeasurable (idiom); unfathomable depths
incomprehensible
enigmatic and impossible to predict
entries.mapullExplanation: 深得无法测量。比喻对事物的情况捉摸不透。

cedictSenses: lit. like a sheet of loose sand
fig. unable to cooperate (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 比喻力量分散，没有组织起来。

cedictSenses: to lean unsteadily from side to side (idiom)
to sway
(of buildings etc) to lean at a crazy angle
entries.mapullExplanation: 指行走不稳，身不由主。也形容物体倾斜不正。

cedictSenses: each takes what he needs (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 各自选取自己所需要的。

cedictSenses: what's frequently heard can be repeated in detail (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 指听得多了，能够说得很清楚、很详细。

cedictSenses: to turn peril into safety (idiom); to avert a danger (esp. political or medical)
entries.mapullExplanation: 由危险转为平安（多指局势或病情）。

cedictSenses: lit. to send charcoal in snowy weather (idiom)
fig. to provide help in sb's hour of need
entries.mapullExplanation: 在下雪天给人送炭取暖。比喻在别人急需时给以物质上或精神上的帮助。

cedictSenses: lit. to be together from the first beat (idiom)
to hit it off
to click together
to chime in easily
entries.mapullExplanation: 拍：乐曲的段落，也称打拍子。一打拍子就合于乐曲的节奏。比喻困情意相投或有利害关系，一下子就说到一起或结合在一起。

cedictSenses: every word and action (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 每句话，每个行动。

cedictSenses: lit. not cold, yet shivering (idiom)
fig. to tremble with fear
to be terrified
entries.mapullExplanation: 栗：畏惧，发抖。不冷而发抖。形容非常恐惧。

cedictSenses: (idiom) calm; unhurried; composed
entries.mapullExplanation: 不慌张，不忙乱。形容态度镇定，或办事稳重、踏实。

cedictSenses: (idiom) obscure; dubious; shady
entries.mapullExplanation: 指说话含含糊糊，很不清楚。也形容行为暧昧。

cedictSenses: to brave the wind and the billows (idiom); to have high ambitions
entries.mapullExplanation: 船只乘着风势破浪前进。比喻排除困难，奋勇前进。

cedictSenses: to tackle a difficult job (idiom)
to do sth reluctantly
entries.mapullExplanation: 勉：勉强；为：做。勉强去做能力所不及或不愿去做的事。

cedictSenses: (idiom) to get straight to the point
entries.mapullExplanation: 用短柄刀直接刺入。原比喻认定目标，勇猛精进。后比喻说话直接了当，不绕弯子。

cedictSenses: (idiom) just a word or two; a few isolated phrases
entries.mapullExplanation: 个别词句或片断的话。

cedictSenses: sighing voice, wailing breath (idiom)
to heave deep sighs
to sigh in despair
entries.mapullExplanation: 因伤感郁闷或悲痛而发出叹息的声音。

cedictSenses: lit. to like the new, and hate the old (idiom); fig. enamored with new people (e.g. new girlfriend), bored with the old
entries.mapullExplanation: 喜欢新的，厌弃旧的。多指爱情不专一。

cedictSenses: the road to happiness is strewn with setbacks (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 磨：阻碍，困难。好事情在实现、成功前，常常会遇到许多波折。

cedictSenses: (idiom) to study sth in order to apply it
entries.mapullExplanation: 为了实际应用而学习。

cedictSenses: (idiom) in all fairness; objectively speaking
entries.mapullExplanation: 平心：心情平和，不动感情；论：评论。平心静气地给予客观评价。

cedictSenses: more than one can attend to (idiom)
deluged (with inquiries etc)
overwhelmed (by the beauty of the scenery)
entries.mapullExplanation: 暇：空闲。原形容景物繁多，来不及观赏。后多形容来人或事情太多，应付不过来。

cedictSenses: to emerge to meet a historic destiny (idiom)
to arise at an opportune time
able to take advantage of an opportunity
to rise to the occasion
entries.mapullExplanation: 应：顺应；运：原指天命，泛指时机。旧指应天命而产生。现指适应时机而产生。

cedictSenses: (idiom) to skip one's sleep and meals; to be completely wrapped up in one's work
entries.mapullExplanation: 废：停止。顾不得睡觉，忘记了吃饭。形容专心努力。

cedictSenses: satisfied just to get through (idiom); to muddle through
without high ambitions, but getting by
entries.mapullExplanation: 且：暂且。只要能够过得去，就这样过下去。形容胸无大志。

cedictSenses: lit. heart untroubled, spirit pleased (idiom); carefree and relaxed
entries.mapullExplanation: 旷：开阔；怡：愉快。心境开阔，精神愉快。

cedictSenses: to burst with joy (idiom)
to be over the moon
to be elated
entries.mapullExplanation: 怒放：盛开。心里高兴得象花儿盛开一样。形容极其高兴。

cedictSenses: to get married and start a career (idiom)
to settle down
to establish oneself
entries.mapullExplanation: 指男的结了婚，有职业，能独立生活。

cedictSenses: to pursue unremittingly (idiom); to persevere
entries.mapullExplanation: 持：坚持；恒：恒心。长久坚持下去。

cedictSenses: (idiom) in unbroken succession; continuous
entries.mapullExplanation: 一个接着一个而不间断。

cedictSenses: (lit.) not one drop can trickle through (idiom)
(fig.) (of crowds, traffic etc) impenetrable
entries.mapullExplanation: 汇：排泄。象是连水也流不出去。形容拥挤或包围的非常严密。

cedictSenses: brimming with enthusiasm (idiom); full of warmth
entries.mapullExplanation: 热烈的感情充分地流露出来。

cedictSenses: lit. to break the cauldrons and sink the boats (idiom); fig. to cut off one's means of retreat
to burn one's boats
entries.mapullExplanation: 比喻下决心不顾一切地干到底。

cedictSenses: lit. a dagger hidden in smiles (idiom); friendly manners belying hypocritical intentions
when the fox preaches, look to the geese
entries.mapullExplanation: 形容对人外表和气，却阴险毒辣。

cedictSenses: (idiom) to sidestep the question
to answer evasively
entries.mapullExplanation: 回答的不是所问的内容。

cedictSenses: nothing more beautiful can be imagined (idiom)
entries.mapullExplanation: 胜：尽。美好的东西很多，一时看不过来。

cedictSenses: glib of tongue (idiom)
eloquent
entries.mapullExplanation: 能：善于。形容能说会道，有辩才。

cedictSenses: (idiom) to have one's hands full managing one's own affairs
too busy to spare time for anything extra
entries.mapullExplanation: 暇：空闲。光顾自己还来不及。指没有力量再照顾别人。

cedictSenses: (idiom) not on the same wavelength; unable to have a congenial conversation; to not see eye to eye
entries.mapullExplanation: 投机：意见相合。形容话说不到一起。

cedictSenses: (idiom) (to move or do sth) softly; quietly; gently
entries.mapullExplanation: 手脚动作很轻，使没有响声。

cedictSenses: to reveal the cloven foot (idiom); to unmask one's true nature
to give the game away
entries.mapullExplanation: 比喻暴露了隐蔽的事实真相。

cedictSenses: too high to reach (idiom); eminent and unapproachable
entries.mapullExplanation: 攀：抓住高处的东西向上爬。高得手也攀不到。形容难以达到。也形容人高高在上，使人难接近。
